resources.string: Shows a short hint while the app is open when the device is hot, short of memory or almost out of room for games. Each hint appears at most once every 30 minutes.
No notices since the app started.
The device is running hot. Pause downloads or give it a rest to keep things smooth.
The device is low on memory. Close other apps if Valkyr feels slow.
Almost no room left for games (under 1 GB free in the download folder).
